Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body: Player A is the predator of Player B. both Player A and Player B are ousted at the same time due to a political action. I play Life Boon on Player A. Do I get the VP for Player B's oust immediately? or do I have to wait until Player A gets a VP in the future?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Card text is always appreciated (required).

Anyway, you get immediatly the VP gained by A. A gains his or her 6 pool.
